item.title: Message from Fire Marshal Jimmy Williams
item.description: MONTGOMERY COUNTY, TX- With cooler weather, we are already seeing a spike in heating related fires. item.title: Local Police Chief Says the Latest Trend in Auto Thefts has Arrived
item.description: Roman Forest Police Chief Stephen Carlisle says a nationwide uptick in thefts of GMC and Chevrolet vehicles has now impacted local residents. Over a two-week span, thieves targeted the Tavola neighborhood three times, bringing the number of thefts to eight in that community.
